reason: A browser voice-input and reply-reading plugin for the DeepSeek Harness chat composer, using Web Speech recognition and host or browser text-to-speech playback.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框提供语音转文字、按住说话发送以及助手回复朗读功能。
summaries.en: Adds speech-to-text input, hold-to-talk message sending, and spoken assistant replies to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer.

capabilities: Accesses the browser microphone through Web Speech API
Converts speech to text and appends it to the chat composer
Submits hold-to-talk messages to the host chat interface
Requests host /api/tts audio for assistant reply playback
Falls back to browser speechSynthesis for reply playback
